issue.title: 「bug」　调用x.ai的bug，claude调用400错误、codex调用422错误
issue.body:
系统：macos26
软件：magpie、codex
版本：都是最新版
bug：
magpie加入grok官key
使用codex经magpie调用grok的模型出现422错误
返回
状态

422

上游返回

xAI: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: tools[6].type: unknown variant `custom`, expected one of `function`, `web_search`, `x_search`, `image_generation`, `collections_search`, `file_search`, `code_execution`, `code_interpreter`, `mcp`, `shell`, `tool_search`

comments.body:
修好了，分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-1024pm（commit [8ecab590](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/8ecab590)，基于当前 main dd1e8822，可直接 cherry-pick）。

**根因**正是这条 422 的措辞：magpie 认得出「上游拒绝 custom 工具」的几种说法（DeepSeek 的 `Unsupported custom tool: 'exec'`、`Invalid tool type: 'custom'` 等，`internal/gateway/custom_tool.go` 的 `customToolRefusal`），认出后会把 custom 工具改写成 function 重新发（#2656 的机制），并且从此对该模型都这么发。但 xAI 这条是 Rust 反序列化的原文——`unknown variant \`custom\``——一个词都对不上，兜底一次也没触发，Codex 每次都撞上 422。

**修复**：把 `unknown variant \`custom\`` 这种 serde 措辞加入识别。第一次 422 之后 magpie 记住该模型不吃 custom 工具，当次就改走 function 翻译重发，之后的请求直接按翻译发。你提到的 claude 调用 400 那半边没有错误原文，如果升级后还出现，把 400 的返回体贴上来——那多半是另一处翻译缺口。

Turning the plugin off turns the subscription off with it; removing it records `removed` (accounts kept with the plugin's sign-ins), and installing it again gives the subscription back. - **Not moved:** the user still has accounts from the built-in: the move hasn't run yet, or it failed (tried again after six hours). Nothing serves them until it runs. - **Retired:** the built-in's code is gone (`retiredBuiltins` in `internal/provider/migrate.go`; `provider.BuiltinRetired(id)`). The plugin serves it, moved or not. Accounts not moved yet are served by nothing; a line over the Providers list says so, with why and a Move (`providers.unmoved`, `unmovedLine` in app.js). With no row of its own, the Add sheet leaves it to the Plugins page (`unusedSub`). Every subscription in the table above is retired (10-17); gates ask `provider.PluginServes(id)` (moved or retired). The plugin does everything: sign-in, refresh, models, requests, usage and errors. It runs in the plugin host (`internal/plugin`). The built-ins' sign-in, models, usage and gateway translators are gone. What is left of them in `internal/provider` (and `internal/qoder/endpoints.go`) reads the built-in's saved accounts so the mover can carry them over. The gateway sends every request to the plugin's fetch. So a bug report about one of these subscriptions is usually about the plugin: 1. Check whether the user's subscription is moved. A moved provider's row in `/api/providers` has `move.state == "plugin"`; the provider id is in `onPlugins`. 2. Fix the plugin in the community repo, [magpie-community/plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins) (`packages/`, provider id = the built-in's id; checked out locally at `~/workspace/projects/magpie-commuity-plugins`). Publish a new version. 3. Raise the mover's `min` to that version. `keepMovedCurrent` then updates every moved user's plugin. This magpie-side code still runs for moved subscriptions: - the plugin host: `internal/plugin`, `host.js`; - `internal/provider/plugins.go`, `plugin_usage.go` (`movedCards`) and `pluginsignin.go`; - the move itself: `internal/provider/migrate*.go`; - the GUI's plugin paths in `internal/gui/assets/app.js`: `subOf`, `pluginSubs` and `startPluginSignIn`. 基于当前最新的 main（`e9bde25`），把之前 required 补齐逻辑整理完善，并修复了一个在流式转发时会导致客户端直接报错拒收的阻断性问题：

### 问题背景
1. **空 object schema 缺失 required**：Claude Code 发送的无参工具（如 `CronList`、`EnterPlanMode`）缺少 `required` 字段，xAI 仍会按 null 校验报错 `400 [standard_violation] /required: null is not of type "array"`。
2. **xAI 流式响应缺失 index 字段**：在 xAI 的 Anthropic 兼容流式输出中，所有的 `content_block_delta` 事件都漏掉了 `index` 字段（仅在 start 和 stop 事件中带有），导致部分严格校验协议格式的客户端解码器（例如 ZCode 等）报错 `["index"]: expected number, received undefined` 并直接判错丢弃整轮输出。

### 修复与分支
- `toolsRequiredFilled`：递归确保所有 `type: "object"` 节点在缺失或为 null 时补全 `"required": []`，原有的有效数组保持原样；
- `xaiIndexTidy`：在 SSE 流式 passthrough 链路中跟踪活跃的 block index，并自动为缺失 index 的 `content_block_delta` 补齐 index；
- 附带了自包含的单元测试（`xai_body_test.go` 与 `xai_stream_index_test.go`）以及文档更新。

When preparing or reviewing a PR, follow the same page's documentation update, semantic change description, and review rules. ## Code standards Write and review changes against the [code standards](docs/code-standards.md). ## Community PRs Before reviewing a community PR, read [contributors](docs/contributors.md): what stops a review for possible harm, what is closed unreviewed, and the authors whose PRs are closed on sight. ## Lessons Before changing code, read [LESSONS.md](LESSONS.md): what recent merged work got wrong and the rule that would have caught it. ## Built-in subscriptions that a plugin serves These built-in subscriptions are retired. Reaching them can break their vendors' terms, so they moved out of magpie into community OpenCode plugins, which keeps magpie itself from being banned. Each one has a plugin that does the same job: | Subscription | id | Plugin (npm) | Mover | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Command Code | `commandcode-plan` | `@magpie-community/opencode-commandcode-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_side.go` | | Cursor | `cursor` | `@magpie-community/opencode-cursor-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_side.go` | | Devin | `devin` | `@magpie-community/opencode-devin-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_side.go` | | Factory | `factory` | `@magpie-community/opencode-factory-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_factory.go` | | Grok | `grok` | `@magpie-community/opencode-grok-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_side.go` | | Kiro | `kiro` | `@magpie-community/opencode-kiro-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_kiro.go` | | Xiaomi MiMo | `mimo-app` | `@magpie-community/opencode-mimo-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_mimo.go` | | Qoder, Qoder CN | `qoder`, `qoder-cn` | `@magpie-community/opencode-qoder-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_qoder.go` | | WorkBuddy, WorkBuddy AI | `workbuddy`, `workbuddy-ai` | `@magpie-community/opencode-workbuddy-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_workbuddy.go` | | ZCode | `zcode` | `@magpie-community/opencode-zcode-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_zcode.go` | | Zed | `zed` | `@magpie-community/opencode-zed-auth` | `internal/provider/migrate_zed.go` | The `movers` map in `internal/provider/migrate*.go` is the source of truth. `TestMovedBuiltinsSayTheirPlugin` fails when a mover has no notice in its code. ### Which code actually runs Two cases decide it: - **Moved:** the user moved the subscription onto its plugin, from the editor's "Move to plugin" (or `provider.Adopt`). Its `migrations.json` state is `plugin` (`provider.Moved(id)`). A new user never sees a deprecated built-in: the Add sheet leaves one with no account out (`unusedSub` in app.js), so it is installed from the Plugins page. A user who installs the plugin themselves is moved too (`provider.HandOver`): at once when the built-in has no accounts, from the gateway's hourly loop (`KeepRetiringMoved`) when it has, unless the plugin is signed in under its own `-plugin` id already. Until then the Add sheet shows the plugin's tile only (`replacedSub` in app.js). Since 10-16 the built-ins are being retired: the hourly loop's `MoveRetiring` moves every subscription with a mover that still has built-in accounts, a user who moved back included, and there is no way back. Turning the plugin off turns the subscription off with it; removing it records `removed` (accounts kept with the plugin's sign-ins), and installing it again gives the subscription back. - **Not moved:** the user still has accounts from the built-in: the move hasn't run yet, or it failed (tried again after six hours). Nothing serves them until it runs. - **Retired:** the built-in's code is gone (`retiredBuiltins` in `internal/provider/migrate.go`; `provider.BuiltinRetired(id)`). The plugin serves it, moved or not. Accounts not moved yet are served by nothing; a line over the Providers list says so, with why and a Move (`providers.unmoved`, `unmovedLine` in app.js). With no row of its own, the Add sheet leaves it to the Plugins page (`unusedSub`). Every subscription in the table above is retired (10-17); gates ask `provider.PluginServes(id)` (moved or retired). The plugin does everything: sign-in, refresh, models, requests, usage and errors. It runs in the plugin host (`internal/plugin`). The built-ins' sign-in, models, usage and gateway translators are gone. What is left of them in `internal/provider` (and `internal/qoder/endpoints.go`) reads the built-in's saved accounts so the mover can carry them over. The gateway sends every request to the plugin's fetch. So a bug report about one of these subscriptions is usually about the plugin: 1. Check whether the user's subscription is moved. A moved provider's row in `/api/providers` has `move.state == "plugin"`; the provider id is in `onPlugins`. 2. Fix the plugin in the community repo, [magpie-community/plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins) (`packages/`, provider id = the built-in's id; checked out locally at `~/workspace/projects/magpie-commuity-plugins`). Publish a new version. 3. Raise the mover's `min` to that version. `keepMovedCurrent` then updates every moved user's plugin. This magpie-side code still runs for moved subscriptions: - the plugin host: `internal/plugin`, `host.js`; - `internal/provider/plugins.go`, `plugin_usage.go` (`movedCards`) and `pluginsignin.go`; - the move itself: `internal/provider/migrate*.go`; - the GUI's plugin paths in `internal/gui/assets/app.js`: `subOf`, `pluginSubs` and `startPluginSignIn`. The parity tests, `internal/gateway/plugin_*_test.go`, hold each plugin to what its built-in did. {"error":{"message":"xAI: Invalid request content: Schema validation failed: [standard_violation] /required: null is not of type \"array\"","type":"invalid_request_error"},"type":"error"}
附claude提示：
⏺ API Error: 400 xAI: Invalid request content: Schema validation failed: [standard_violation]
  /required: null is not of type "array"

这第三条也修好了，还在同一分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-1024pm（commit [c172b65d](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c172b65d)，接在 d8ad9ab2 之后，直接 cherry-pick 这个新提交即可）。

**根因**：这次是工具 schema 里的空 required。某个工具的 `input_schema` 写了 `"required": null`（一个必填都没有时 Claude Code 自己的工具、或它挂的 MCP server 的工具会这么写；Anthropic 的 API 收下 null，所以直连 Anthropic 从不报错），而 xAI 会把每个工具的 schema 当 JSON Schema 校验，根上或嵌套里的 null 都拒收，报的就是这条 `/required: null is not of type "array"`。magpie 此前直通转发，原样送到。

**修复**（`internal/gateway/xai_body.go`，对 api.x.ai 的直通和翻译两条路径、三种 schema 形态——`input_schema`、`parameters`、`function` 下的 `parameters`——都生效）：null 的 `required` 键删掉，schema 根上和嵌套里（`properties` 里子对象的）都清；真正的数组（如 Bash 的 `"required":["command"]`）原样保留；没有 null required 的请求体一字节不动。

**验证**：按你报的原文措辞在假 xAI 上重放了 claude 调用（Bash 的真实 required 数组 + 一个根上 null 的 MCP 风格工具 + 一个嵌套 null 的），通过，真实数组与 schema 其余内容原样到达；关掉该整形时两个新测试全红。全量 nogui gateway 包测试里 4 个红（TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged、TestCodexFittedImagesPastTheBudget、TestMarshalRawIsEncodingJSON、FuzzMarshalRaw）与同会话干净基线逐一对上（环境性的），基线里那个已知 flake（TestHandedOverGatewayFinishesItsStream）本次反而绿；gofmt / go vet 干净，三平台构建通过。真实 xAI 本地仍无法验证——方便的话再跑一轮 claude→grok；如果还有别的 400，把上游返回体贴上来。

{"error":{"message":"xAI: Invalid request content: Schema validation failed: [standard_violation] /required: null is not of type \"array\"","type":"invalid_request_error"},"type":"error"}
claude还是出现这样的错误

又找到一处上一条修复里的真实缺口，还在同一分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/issue-batch-1024pm（commit [bf84dd4f](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/bf84dd4f86d236771ef3e8a3751a8b91f4a9c1a8)，接在 c172b65d 之后，直接 cherry-pick 这个新提交即可）。

**先确认一件事**：上一条修复（c172b65d）已经会把每个工具 schema 根上和 properties 对象里的 `"required": null` 删掉——如果你的 null 在那些位置，升级后这条错误应该已经消失。所以请先确认这次构建的代码里真的包含 c172b65d（`git log --oneline -5` 能看到它），排除升级没生效的可能。

**这次重读修复代码，找到一个真实缺口**：清理函数只沿着 schema 的对象往下递归，没有走进数组。MCP server 工具的 schema（尤其 zod 生成的那类）经常把子 schema 放进 `anyOf`/`oneOf`（union）或元组形式的 `items`——null 若挂在数组里的某个分支上，就原样穿过整形到达 xAI，报的还是同一条 `/required: null`。我上一条说「嵌套里都清」只对对象嵌套成立，数组嵌套漏了。

**修复**：清理函数对数组和对象同样递归，`anyOf`/`oneOf`/`allOf`/`items` 里的分支都清；真实的 required 数组（如 Bash 的 `["command"]`）依旧原样保留；没有 null required 的请求体一个字节不动。

**验证**：按你报的原文措辞在假 xAI 上重放 claude 调用，请求里带两个 MCP 风格工具——一个 schema 的 null required 在 `anyOf` 分支上、一个在元组 `items` 里——旧代码红（400 原文逐字复现）、新代码绿，schema 其余内容原样到达；前几轮的全部措辞（`unknown variant \`custom\``、compaction blob、Invalid message role、根上/对象嵌套的 null required）不回归，`go test ./internal/gateway -run 'TestXAI|TestXai|TestCustom'` 23 项绿；gateway 包全量 nogui 在修复前后两次跑，4 个失败逐个相同（均为本机已知环境性的）；gofmt / go vet / linux+windows 构建干净。真实 xAI 上游本地无法调用，未验证。

**如果更新后还是这条 400**：把这次请求体 `tools` 数组里报错那个工具的 `input_schema` 原文贴上来——null 具体藏在哪个位置就能直接看到，不用再猜。

非常感谢，经过实测claude调用x.ai的问题已经修改完成
后续会合并回主线吗？
@yetone 当前bug我已经确认这个修复是有用的，希望可以尽快加入正式版

issue.title: [Bug] Codex 桌面端 + Grok 4.7（SuperGrok）必现 400：Argument not supported: "output.encrypted_content" in "include" field

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
**环境**

- magpie `0.1.1710`（Windows amd64 桌面版，网关 `127.0.0.1:3425`）
- 客户端：**Codex 桌面端**（trace 里 `agent=codex`，8 轮会话、prompt ≈ 97k tokens）
- 上游：**Grok（SuperGrok 订阅登录）**，模型 `grok/grok-4.7@500k`，`effort=medium`

**现象**

在 Codex 里把模型从 GPT 切到 `Grok 4.7 @ 500k`，发第一句「你好」就失败：

```
Grok (SuperGrok): Argument not supported: "output.encrypted_content" in "include" field
```

即上游 xAI 拒绝了请求里的 `include` 字段，magpie 把该错误原样抛回。

**最小复现（直接打 magpie，不经 Codex）**

```bash
# A. 复现：include 带 output.encrypted_content
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/responses \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'authorization: Bearer x' \
  -d '{"model":"grok/grok-4.7@500k","input":"hi","include":["output.encrypted_content"],"max_output_tokens":16}'
# => HTTP 400
# {"error":{"message":"Grok (SuperGrok): Argument not supported: \"output.encrypted_content\" in \"include\" field","type":"invalid_request_error"}}

# B. 对照：同样的请求，include 换成 reasoning.encrypted_content
# => HTTP 200，且响应 output 里带 encrypted_content：
#    "output":[{"encrypted_content":"A/M3sA0v..."}]

# C. 对照：不带 include
# => HTTP 200
```

**定位**

- `include` 是 magpie 按设计原样透传给 Responses 上游的：`internal/gateway/ir.go` 里 `Include []string` 的注释写着「Codex's reasoning.encrypted_content … which a Responses upstream is asked for too (#315)」。
- 但 **Codex 桌面端这次发的是 `output.encrypted_content`**（不是 `reasoning.encrypted_content`），这个取值 xAI 的 Responses 接口不认，直接 400。
- 关键点：**xAI 并不是不支持加密推理** —— B 组用 `reasoning.encrypted_content` 是 200，响应里也确实回了 `encrypted_content`。所以问题在「`include` 取值没有按 provider 适配」，而不是上游能力缺失。

**建议**

1. 按 provider 维护 `include` 白名单，透传前丢掉上游不认的项（trace / 日志里标注 dropped）。
2. 或做等价映射：`output.encrypted_content` → `reasoning.encrypted_content`（xAI 支持），保证 Codex 仍拿得到 `encrypted_content`。
3. 回归用例：grok provider + `include: ["output.encrypted_content"]` 不得 400。

**影响面**

Codex 桌面端 + Grok（SuperGrok）属于**必现**：切到 Grok 后第一条消息即失败，无法使用。反馈者表示之前用 GPT 正常、最近才出现，怀疑与 Codex 客户端改为发送 `output.encrypted_content` 有关；若是这样，magpie 这边的容错就更有必要（客户端字段会变，网关不该被一个未知 include 值整条打断）。

**trace**

`/v1/magpie/trace` → `id=1793090187588`，`2026-10-27T16:36:27+08:00`，`agent=codex`，`model=grok/grok-4.7@500k`，`effort=medium`，`status=400`，`6142 ms`；`tries[0].error` 与上面一致。

**相关**

#3392 也是 xAI 上游字段不兼容（`tools[].type: custom` → 422），与本题不是同一字段，但可对照看：目前 magpie 对「上游不支持的字段/取值」整体缺少降级策略。

timeline.body:
已在 [v0.1.1856](https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.1856) 发布（e23ddddd5 及前三个提交），更新后可以再试试。

- codex：x.ai 回 422 `tools[N].type: unknown variant \`custom\`` 时，现在按 custom 工具不被支持处理，改以 function 发出，模型的调用仍还原成 `custom_tool_call`。之后 Codex 交回的 reasoning 里 `"content": null` 会去掉，不再报 compaction blob 错误。
- claude：对话中途的 system 消息并入顶层 system，不再报 `Invalid message role`；工具 schema 里的 `"required": null`（包括嵌套和 anyOf 里的）发往 api.x.ai 前去掉。
- 只作用于 api.x.ai，其他上游收到的请求不变。

测试用你报告里的错误原文做假 x.ai 上游，没有对真实 x.ai 发请求（这边没有 key）。issue 先开着，等你确认没问题再关；还有问题直接在这里说。

The fix is out in v0.1.1856. Please update and try again; this stays open until you confirm it works.

issue.title: [Bug] DeepSeek 原生 Responses 转发未适配 Codex 的 custom exec，返回 400 后也不尝试健康后备（v0.1.1273）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 现象

Codex 请求包含 `{"type":"custom","name":"exec",...}` 时，Magpie 将这个工具声明原样发到官方 DeepSeek 的 `/v1/responses`，收到：

```text
DeepSeek: Unsupported custom tool: 'exec'. Only 'apply_patch' is supported.
```

只声明工具、尚未调用，也会触发。直接点名 DeepSeek 和使用含 DeepSeek 的有序路由组都能触发；组内存在健康后备时，Magpie 收到这个 400 后仍结束请求，没有尝试后备。

## 环境与证据边界

- 运行版本：官方发布二进制 `magpie v0.1.1273`，Linux arm64。
- 真实运行记录：DeepSeek 官方上游返回上述 400，接口为 `/v1/responses`；路由记录中只有一次 DeepSeek 尝试，没有尝试排在后面的候选。
- 本地复现：使用从运行容器复制的同版二进制、临时配置、Python 标准库假上游；整个测试在独立网络空间内运行，不访问生产实例或真实 DeepSeek。
- 假上游只模拟已收到的拒绝条件：Responses 中 `custom` 工具名称不是 `apply_patch` 时返回上述 400。测试观察的对象是 Magpie 实际转发的请求体及是否进入后备。
- 没有重新对真实 DeepSeek 发请求，也没有完整重放原始长会话；不声称验证了最新版本或最新 main。

## 最小复现

1. DeepSeek provider 同时配置 Chat 和 Responses 地址，与内置预设一致。在隔离复现中，将两个地址分别指向本地假上游的 `/deepseek/v1`。
2. 添加一个能接受同一请求并返回 200 的假 Responses provider，作为健康后备。
3. 配置一个不含分类器、按顺序尝试成员的组：

```json
{
  "id": "repro",
  "name": "Reproduction",
  "routing": "order",
  "members": [
    "deepseek/deepseek-flash",
    "fallback/fallback-model"
  ]
}
```

4. 向 Magpie 的 `/v1/responses` 发送：

```json
{
  "model": "group/repro",
  "stream": true,
  "input": [
    {"role": "user", "content": "Return ok."}
  ],
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "custom",
      "name": "exec",
      "description": "Execute source text.",
      "format": {"type": "text"}
    }
  ]
}
```

5. 观察到假 DeepSeek 收到的仍是 `type: custom`、`name: exec`；客户端收到 400；健康后备收到的请求数为 0。

将 `model` 改为 `deepseek/deepseek-flash` 仍然返回同一 400。将 `stream` 改为 `false` 也能复现。因此，自动分类、额度耗尽、长历史和路由组都不是触发工具兼容问题的必要条件。

文末内嵌的 `reproduce.py` 可以直接驱动官方二进制，只有 Python 标准库依赖。将待测二进制与脚本放在同一目录并命名为 `magpie-v0.1.1273`，运行：

```bash
python3 reproduce.py
```

也可以通过第一个参数传入待测二进制。脚本使用临时 HOME/XDG 配置、假凭证、仅监听回环的假上游，并在 finally 中停止测试进程。测试环境另外使用 Linux 的独立网络空间阻断外部访问：

```bash
TASK_DIR=/absolute/path/to/repro
bwrap --unshare-net --ro-bind / / \
  --bind "$TASK_DIR" "$TASK_DIR" --chdir "$TASK_DIR" \
  /usr/bin/python3 "$TASK_DIR/reproduce.py"
```

脚本把正确行为设为成功处理请求，因此当前版本最后会以断言失败退出；此前的输出和 `evidence.json` 记录了已复现的 400、发往上游的工具类型及后备调用次数。

## 对照实验

同版二进制运行了两轮；第二轮覆盖以下八个场景：

| 输入或配置 | 客户端结果 | 假上游实际收到的请求 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `custom exec`，原生 Responses，有序组 | 400 | 仅 DeepSeek Responses，工具仍是 custom |
| `custom exec`，直接点名 DeepSeek | 400 | 仅 DeepSeek Responses |
| `custom exec`，`stream: true`，有序组 | 400 | 仅 DeepSeek Responses |
| 工具只改名为 `custom apply_patch` | 200 | DeepSeek Responses |
| 工具改为普通 `function exec` | 200 | DeepSeek Responses |
| 首个成员返回额度 429，然后尝试 DeepSeek | 400 | 额度上游 → DeepSeek；没有尝试健康后备 |
| 保持相同请求，只将假上游的拒绝文本改为 `Unknown parameter: unsupported_tool` | 200 | DeepSeek → 健康后备 |
| 保留 `custom exec`，仅去掉 DeepSeek Responses 地址，走现有 Chat 转换 | 200 | DeepSeek Chat，工具转换成 function |

最后一项不只检查 200。假 Chat 上游实际收到 `function exec`，其参数 schema 包含字符串 `input`；它返回参数 `{"input":"print(1)"}` 后，Magpie 交给 Responses 客户端的是：

```json
{
  "type": "custom_tool_call",
  "name": "exec",
  "input": "print(1)",
  "call_id": "call_local"
}
```

这些对照证明：Magpie 已有工具转换与回程还原能力；原生 Responses 路径没有使用这套兼容处理。对照同时证明了后备本身可用，而这条具体错误未触发后备。

## 源码定位

以下链接全部固定到已复现的 `v0.1.1273`，不使用其他版本本地检出的行号。

### 1. 原生 Responses 路径绕过现有 custom 转换

- [internal/provider/presets.go:142](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/provider/presets.go#L142)：DeepSeek 内置预设同时声明 Chat、Responses 和 Anthropic 地址。
- [internal/gateway/gateway.go:3473](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L3473)：`attempt` 根据目标支持的协议决定 `relayable`。这里没有针对 DeepSeek 自定义工具类型的兼容检查。
- [internal/gateway/gateway.go:3523](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L3523)：`relay` 为真时调用 `passthrough` 并返回，未进入后面的 `translate`。
- [internal/gateway/gateway.go:3953](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L3953)：`passthrough` 的 Responses 分支会适配部分字段，但不将 DeepSeek 不接受的 `custom exec` 转成普通函数工具。
- [internal/gateway/responses.go:410](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/responses.go#L410)：现有转换路径在解析 `custom` 时使用 `customDescription` / `customSchema`，并保留 `Custom: true` 的回程信息。
- [internal/gateway/responses.go:1205](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/responses.go#L1205)：重建 Responses 请求时也能将工具输出为普通 `function`。
- [internal/gateway/responses.go:1525](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/responses.go#L1525)：回程将函数调用还原为 `custom_tool_call`，自由文本放回 `input`。

### 2. 该 400 没有触发后备

- [internal/gateway/fallback.go:1081](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/fallback.go#L1081)：`shapeWords` 不匹配 `Unsupported custom tool`。
- [internal/gateway/fallback.go:1157](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.1273/internal/gateway/fallback.go#L1157)：`retryable` 对 400/422 只接受已识别的错误类别；该报错不在其中。
- 真实路由记录及隔离复现均表现为：保留了其他候选，却只尝试 DeepSeek 一次，随后把 400 交回客户端。

## 期望

- 对 DeepSeek 已知不支持的 custom 工具形态进行兼容处理，并保留工具调用和返回值的对应关系。
- 当请求属于允许后备的有序组，且首个上游拒绝的是其自身工具协议能力时，允许兼容的后备接手。
- 不直接丢掉 `exec`，也不将它改名为 `apply_patch`，因为两者语义不同。
- 兼容逻辑限定到相应目标及工具能力，不改变原生支持这些工具的其他 Responses 上游，也不把所有 400 一律视为可重试。

具体采用原生 Responses 适配、复用现有转换或其他实现方式，由维护者决定。

## 未验证

- 没有对真实 DeepSeek 做修复前后的新请求对照；只有已有真实错误记录及本次假上游复现。
- 没有验证最新发布版或最新 main，未运行源码构建和全仓测试。
- 没有完整重放用户原始会话，也不将任务分类是否正确作为本 issue 的已确认缺陷。
- 现有 Chat 转换的 200 和工具调用还原已在假上游验证，不代表真实模型执行质量或完整长会话已验收。

## 复现脚本与脱敏证据

以下脚本与证据直接内嵌在本 issue，无需访问报告者的本地路径或账号。证据只保留假上游请求、返回结果和调用顺序，未包含生产配置、真实凭证、会话标识或账号信息。

<details>
<summary>reproduce.py（完整脚本）</summary>

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise the released Magpie binary against loopback-only fake providers."""

import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import urllib.error
import urllib.request


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BINARY = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve() if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ROOT / "magpie-v0.1.1273"
ERROR = "Unsupported custom tool: 'exec'. Only 'apply_patch' is supported."
EVENTS = []


class Upstream(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    refusal = ERROR

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def reply(self, status, body, content_type="application/json"):
        data = body.encode() if isinstance(body, str) else json.dumps(body).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_CONNECT(self):
        self.reply(502, {"error": "External network is disabled for this reproduction."})

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.endswith("/models"):
            self.reply(200, {"object": "list", "data": []})
        else:
            self.reply(502, {"error": "No external requests are allowed."})

    def do_POST(self):
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))))
        if self.path.startswith("http"):
            self.reply(502, {"error": "No external requests are allowed."})
            return
        EVENTS.append({"path": self.path, "body": body})
        if self.path.startswith("/limited/"):
            self.reply(429, {"error": {"message": "Daily quota exhausted", "code": "insufficient_quota"}})
            return
        tools = body.get("tools", [])
        if self.path.startswith("/deepseek/") and any(
            t.get("type") == "custom" and t.get("name") != "apply_patch" for t in tools
        ):
            self.reply(400, {"error": {"message": self.refusal, "type": "invalid_request_error"}})
            return
        if self.path.endswith("/chat/completions"):
            call = {"index": 0, "id": "call_local", "type": "function",
                    "function": {"name": "exec", "arguments": '{"input":"print(1)"}'}}
            chunks = [
                {"id": "chatcmpl_local", "object": "chat.completion.chunk",
                 "model": body["model"], "choices": [
                     {"index": 0, "delta": {"role": "assistant", "tool_calls": [call]},
                      "finish_reason": None}]},
                {"id": "chatcmpl_local", "object": "chat.completion.chunk",
                 "model": body["model"], "choices": [
                     {"index": 0, "delta": {}, "finish_reason": "tool_calls"}]},
            ]
            self.reply(200, "".join("data: " + json.dumps(c) + "\n\n" for c in chunks)
                       + "data: [DONE]\n\n", "text/event-stream")
            return
        self.reply(200, {
            "id": "resp_local", "object": "response", "created_at": 0,
            "status": "completed", "model": body["model"],
            "output": [{"id": "msg_local", "type": "message", "role": "assistant",
                        "content": [{"type": "output_text", "text": "ok", "annotations": []}]}],
            "usage": {"input_tokens": 1, "output_tokens": 1, "total_tokens": 2},
        })


OPENER = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))


def request(url, payload=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url, data=None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "magpie-repro"},
    )
    try:
        with OPENER.open(req, timeout=15) as response:
            return response.status, response.read().decode()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return error.code, error.read().decode()


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def gateway(chat_only, upstream):
    run = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="chat-" if chat_only else "native-", dir=ROOT))
    config = run / ".config" / "magpie"
    config.mkdir(parents=True)
    providers = [
        {"id": "limited", "name": "Limited", "chat": upstream + "/limited/v1",
         "responses": upstream + "/limited/v1", "key": "local-fixture", "models": ["test-model"]},
        {"id": "deepseek", "name": "DeepSeek", "preset": "deepseek",
         "chat": upstream + "/deepseek/v1", "key": "local-fixture", "models": ["deepseek-flash"]},
        {"id": "fallback", "name": "Healthy fallback", "responses": upstream + "/fallback/v1",
         "key": "local-fixture", "models": ["fallback-model"]},
    ]
    if not chat_only:
        providers[1]["responses"] = upstream + "/deepseek/v1"
    groups = [
        {"id": "repro", "name": "Reproduction", "routing": "order",
         "members": ["deepseek/deepseek-flash", "fallback/fallback-model"]},
        {"id": "quota-repro", "name": "Quota reproduction", "routing": "order",
         "members": ["limited/test-model", "deepseek/deepseek-flash", "fallback/fallback-model"]},
    ]
    (config / "providers.json").write_text(json.dumps({"providers": providers, "groups": groups}))
    (config / "settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"noStats": True, "discoverAccounts": False}))
    (config / "plugins.yml").write_text("preset: essentials\n")
    (config / "last-version").write_text("v0.1.1273")
    port = free_port()
    # A fresh environment and process-only home prevent discovery of real credentials.
    env = {
        "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "LANG": "C.UTF-8",
        "HOME": str(run), "USERPROFILE": str(run),
        "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(run / ".config"), "XDG_CACHE_HOME": str(run / ".cache"),
        "XDG_DATA_HOME": str(run / ".local/share"), "XDG_STATE_HOME": str(run / ".local/state"),
        "APPDATA": str(run / "AppData/Roaming"), "LOCALAPPDATA": str(run / "AppData/Local"),
        "MAGPIE_ADDR": f"127.0.0.1:{port}", "MAGPIE_NO_ACCOUNTS": "1",
        "MAGPIE_NO_STATS": "1", "DO_NOT_TRACK": "1",
        "HTTP_PROXY": upstream, "HTTPS_PROXY": upstream, "ALL_PROXY": upstream,
        "NO_PROXY": "localhost,127.0.0.1",
    }
    log = (run / "process.log").open("w")
    process = subprocess.Popen([str(BINARY), "serve"], cwd=run, env=env,
                               stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}"
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if process.poll() is not None:
                raise RuntimeError("Isolated gateway exited: " + (run / "process.log").read_text()[-2500:])
            try:
                if request(url + "/v1/models")[0] == 200:
                    return process, log, url, run
            except (OSError, urllib.error.URLError):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.05)
        raise RuntimeError("Isolated gateway did not become ready.")
    except BaseException:
        process.terminate()
        process.wait(timeout=5)
        log.close()
        raise


def main():
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Upstream)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    processes = []
    result = {"binary": str(BINARY), "provider": "fake loopback validator", "cases": []}
    custom = {"model": "group/repro", "stream": False,
              "input": [{"role": "user", "content": "Return ok."}],
              "tools": [{"type": "custom", "name": "exec",
                         "description": "Execute source text.", "format": {"type": "text"}}]}

    def case(name, url, payload):
        start = len(EVENTS)
        status, response = request(url + "/v1/responses", payload)
        row = {"name": name, "status": status, "response": response,
               "upstream": copy.deepcopy(EVENTS[start:])}
        result["cases"].append(row)
        print(json.dumps({"case": name, "status": status,
                          "upstream_paths": [e["path"] for e in row["upstream"]]}), flush=True)
        return row

    try:
        endpoint = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}"
        native = gateway(False, endpoint)
        processes.append(native)
        baseline = case("custom_exec_native_group", native[2], custom)
        direct = copy.deepcopy(custom)
        direct["model"] = "deepseek/deepseek-flash"
        case("custom_exec_direct_model", native[2], direct)
        streaming = copy.deepcopy(custom)
        streaming["stream"] = True
        case("custom_exec_streaming_group", native[2], streaming)
        patch = copy.deepcopy(custom)
        patch["tools"][0]["name"] = "apply_patch"
        assert case("custom_apply_patch_control", native[2], patch)["status"] == 200
        function = copy.deepcopy(custom)
        function["tools"] = [{"type": "function", "name": "exec",
                              "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}}}]
        assert case("function_exec_control", native[2], function)["status"] == 200
        quota = copy.deepcopy(custom)
        quota["model"] = "group/quota-repro"
        case("quota_then_custom_exec", native[2], quota)
        Upstream.refusal = "Unknown parameter: unsupported_tool"
        assert case("recognized_shape_error_control", native[2], custom)["status"] == 200
        Upstream.refusal = ERROR
        chat = gateway(True, endpoint)
        processes.append(chat)
        translated = case("custom_exec_via_chat_translation", chat[2], custom)
        assert translated["status"] == 200, translated["response"]
        call = next(item for item in json.loads(translated["response"])["output"]
                    if item.get("type") == "custom_tool_call")
        assert call["name"] == "exec" and call["input"] == "print(1)", call
        tool = translated["upstream"][0]["body"]["tools"][0]
        assert tool["type"] == "function" and tool["function"]["name"] == "exec", tool
        assert tool["function"]["parameters"]["properties"]["input"]["type"] == "string", tool
        print("CONTROL PASS: custom exec round-trips through existing Chat translation.", flush=True)
        result["expected_fixed_status"] = 200
        result["bug_reproduced"] = baseline["status"] == 400 and ERROR in baseline["response"]
        result["native_tool_type"] = baseline["upstream"][0]["body"]["tools"][0]["type"]
        result["native_fallback_calls"] = sum(
            event["path"].startswith("/fallback/") for event in baseline["upstream"]
        )
        (ROOT / "evidence.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
        assert baseline["status"] == 200, (
            "BUG REPRODUCED: Codex custom exec request returns 400; "
            "healthy fallback is not tried. See evidence.json."
        )
    finally:
        for process, log, _, _ in reversed(processes):
            process.terminate()
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                process.kill()
                process.wait(timeout=5)
            log.close()
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=5)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

issue.title: gateway: a key relay that proxies Grok gets Codex's null-content reasoning unshaped, so xAI answers "Could not decode the compaction blob" and nothing retries

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
中文摘要：`xai_body.go` / `grokBody` 对「Codex 交回的 reasoning 带 `"content": null`」的整形只覆盖 `api.x.ai` 和官方 Grok 订阅账号。当一个**第三方 Relay** 自己代理 Grok、地址不是 `api.x.ai`（这里是 `opencode-go`），整形一次都不生效，xAI 回 `Could not decode the compaction blob`；同时这条措辞不命中 `foreignReasoning`，magpie 既不剥离 reasoning 重试，也不 failover，400 直接交给客户端。#3392 已修 `api.x.ai` 这一侧，并明确写了「只作用于 api.x.ai，其他上游收到的请求不变」，所以这个缺口是已知边界内的遗漏，不是回归。

## What happens

A routing group's member is a key-based relay that proxies Grok over the Responses API (`opencode-go`, serving `grok-4.7`). Once a conversation contains a sealed reasoning item that the client hands back, every later turn fails:

```text
Remote magpie: OpenCode Go: Could not decode the compaction blob. Ensure it is unmodified from the compact response.
```

Status 400, **one try only** — no reasoning stripped and re-sent, no failover to the group's other members.

The request the client sends carries the reasoning item as Codex writes it:

```json
{
  "type": "reasoning",
  "id": "rs_e019e9bf-…",
  "summary": [ … ],
  "content": null,
  "encrypted_content": "kwXW0nttC7c4…"
}
```

magpie's own comment says the backend cannot read the encrypted reasoning beside a null content (`internal/provider/grok.go:230`): *"Codex hands reasoning back with `"content": null`, which the backend can't read the encrypted reasoning beside (`Could not decode the compaction blob`), so a null content goes."* The relay is a different address, so nothing removes it.

## The three gates that all miss a relay

| Layer | Code | Gate | Why a relay misses it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Grok subscription shaping | `provider/grok.go` `grokBody`, attached in `grokAccount` (`acct.body = grokBody`, `:176`) | `Provider.Prepare`: `if p.Account != nil && p.Account.body != nil` (`provider/account.go:293`) | a key-based relay has no `Account` |
| xAI's own API shaping | `gateway/xai_body.go` `xaiBody` → `withoutNullReasoningContent` | `if p.Host() != "api.x.ai" { return body }` (`:41`) | `Host()` is the provider's own base URL host (`provider.go:1766`), i.e. the relay's, never `api.x.ai` |
| Strip-and-retry on refusal | `gateway/affinity.go:639` `foreignReasoning`, used by `withoutUnreadable` (`codex_backend.go:1047`) and `withoutRefused` | regex needs `invalid_encrypted_content`, or `encrypted content … could not be verified/decrypted`, or `could not decrypt/verify … encrypted content` | the wording has no "encrypted content" at all |

The second row is the deliberate boundary from #3392. The maintainer stated it at release: *「只作用于 api.x.ai，其他上游收到的请求不变。」* For a relay that is literally the same vendor behind another hostname, that boundary is where this report lives.

Because `retryable(400, body)` (`gateway/fallback.go:1197`) matches none of `quotaWords | unservedWords | refusedWords | shapeWords | unsaidWords | regionWords`, the failure is classified `failOther` with no rest, so the 400 is handed to the client unchanged after a single attempt.

## Evidence

Read from the instance that owns the relay, not the one the client talks to.

- `opencode-go` is a key provider (`account: false`) whose base URL is `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1` (`chat` and `responses` alike), so `p.Host()` is `opencode.ai`, and there is no `Account` for either shaping gate to find. Its model list carries `grok-4.6` and `grok-4.7`.
- The group's own trace for two failing turns names what was tried and for how long:

```text
15:11:28  agent=codex  model=group/auto  status=400  fail=other
          tries: opencode-go / grok-4.7 / 400 / "other"
15:13:49  agent=codex  model=group/auto  status=400  fail=other
          tries: opencode-go / grok-4.7 / 400 / "other"
```

  One try each: no reasoning stripped and re-sent, no second member asked. The same session answered 200 one minute earlier on a non-Grok member (`15:10:50`), and again after the incident once the conversation had moved off `grok-4.7`, which is what makes this "the turn that first reached the Grok relay" rather than a conversation-wide failure.
- The two hops: this instance has only `remote-magpie` (`responses: http://…:3425/v1`) and `viper` as providers, so the client never talks to the relay directly; the reverse is likewise true — the instance that owns the relay reports `group/auto` as its own model, not `remote-magpie/group/auto`. The `Remote magpie:` prefix on the client's error is the first hop relaying the second hop's words.

### What the request actually carried

The captured `POST /v1/responses` for the `15:13:49` failure (`3,136,507` bytes, `model: group/auto`, `from: responses` → `to: responses`, provider `opencode-go`) has **688 input items: 100 `reasoning`, 227 `function_call`, 227 `function_call_output`, 134 `message`. Every one of the 100 reasoning items carries `"content": null` — and exactly one of them carries a sealed blob:**

```text
reasoning items                       : 100
  with "content": null                : 100
  with a non-empty encrypted_content  :   1   -> input[681], 1,903 bytes
```

`input[681]`, the only item with a body, is:

```json
{
  "type": "reasoning",
  "id": "rs_e019e9bf-f738-9435-af18-2dbe1ae707e3",
  "summary": [{ "type": "summary_text", "text": "…" }],
  "content": null,
  "encrypted_content": "kwXW0nttC7c4yjHcslkkooQbkZkwLWJ0e1zxpyUmXfShAJT+1q3sjfdwR3ug…"
}
```

That ordering is worth stating, because it explains the shape of the failure: the null content is universal (Codex writes it on all 100), so a null beside an **empty** `encrypted_content` is evidently tolerated — 99 of them went by. The turn only breaks once one reasoning item carries a **real** blob, i.e. the first turn after the conversation reached the Grok member. `include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"]` and `reasoning: { "effort": "high", "summary": "auto" }` are on the request, so Codex is asking for exactly this.

The relay's answer, verbatim, is a client-facing rejection:

```json
{"error":{"code":null,"message":"OpenCode Go: Could not decode the compaction blob. Ensure it is unmodified from the compact response.","param":null,"type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

`code: null`, `param: null`, `type: invalid_request_error` — the same shape as the Qoder case in #4411: a failed conversation labelled as a bad request, which is why `retryable(400, …)` refuses it and no member is retried.

One more observation, offered as a latent issue rather than a cause: the request's 24 tools are 13 `namespace`, 10 `function` and 1 `web_search`. `grokBody` flattens namespaces (`grokFlat`, `provider/grok.go`) and `grokTools` allows only the types the backend takes. On this relay path neither runs, so 13 namespace tools go upstream as written. The compaction-blob refusal is what surfaces, so nothing here proves the namespaces are refused too — but a relay serving Grok inherits both gaps at once.

## Proposal

Either would close it; the first is the one that generalizes.

1. **Let a provider declare that its upstream is Grok, instead of inferring it from the host.** `xaiBody`'s three shapings (null reasoning content, mid-conversation system turns, `"required": null`) are properties of xAI's parser, not of the hostname `api.x.ai`. A relay, a preset, or a plugin know they proxy Grok; they simply have no way to say so. A per-provider flag (or a preset/preset-adjacent field) would make the existing code reach them, and the wording stays in one place.
2. **Narrow fix: add the refusal to `foreignReasoning`.** `could not decode the compaction blob` costs one regex alternative and turns the 400 into a strip-and-retry plus failover, which is what the group is for. It does not stop the regrouping from recurring each turn, and it trusts wording — but it fails toward working, and it helps every client, not only Codex.

Failing both, an `opencode-go`-style relay stays unusable for any Codex conversation that ever contains sealed reasoning — which, after the first turn on that member, is all of them.

## Workaround

`/compact` in Codex (or a new session) drops the sealed blobs and the conversation continues, until it next reaches the Grok member.

## Environment

- Instance that owns the relay: magpie v0.1.1719. That build also predates v0.1.1856, so neither the relay path nor the `api.x.ai` path is shaped there.
- Instance the client talks to: magpie v0.1.1566 (`e5dd8696`), one hop upstream of it as `remote-magpie`.
- Client: Codex CLI over the Responses API. Relay: `opencode-go` (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`), model `grok-4.7`.

Upgrading both to v0.1.1856 or later covers the `api.x.ai` case but not this one: the relay's host stays `opencode.ai`, so `xaiBody` still returns the body untouched. That is why this is filed as a gap rather than a stale build.

Related: #3392 (the `api.x.ai` path, where these three refusals were fixed and the host boundary was stated), #3887 (sealed `encrypted_content` crossing accounts and providers).

timeline.body:
@yetone 
v0.1.2557 上用 Claude Code 调 xAI，还是报同一个 400：`/required: null is not of type "array"`。

查了一下，这次请求体里没有任何 `"required": null`，问题出在**没写** `required` 的 object schema 上（现在的 Claude Code 里有好几个工具，比如 `CronList`、`EnterPlanMode`、`ExitPlanMode`、`TaskStop`，顶层都没有 `required`）。xAI 好像把没写的 `required` 当成了 null。

直接请求 `api.x.ai/v1/messages` 的最小复现：

- `"input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{}}` 返回 400 `/required: null is not of type "array"`
- `"input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{},"required":[]}` 返回 200，正常回复

所以 `xai_body.go` 现在删掉 null `required` 的做法，结果还是"没写"，照样会被拒。建议改成：对发往 api.x.ai 的工具 schema，凡是 `"type":"object"` 且 `required` 为 null 或没写的地方，都补上 `"required": []`，根 schema 和嵌套的（properties、items、anyOf/oneOf/allOf）都要处理。

issue.title: [Bug] Codex Desktop 经 Copilot 调用 Gemini 返回 400、Grok 4.7 返回 422（简单输入也失败）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题描述

Codex Desktop 通过 Magpie 使用 GitHub Copilot 提供的 Gemini / Grok 模型时，出现以下失败：

- `copilot/gemini-4-argon`：HTTP 400，`Copilot: invalid request body`。
- `copilot/gemini-3.8-flash`：HTTP 400，同一错误；新会话中发送 `hi` 或 `hi check current time` 也失败。
- `copilot/grok-4.7`：HTTP 422，`Copilot: 422 Unprocessable Entity: Unprocessable Entity`；同一轮中连续 6 次 gateway 请求均失败。

2026-10-30 的本机留存记录共包含 **13 次失败、5 个 Codex 会话、6 个失败轮次**。同一时段，Magpie 自身对 Gemini Flash 的 provider test 返回 HTTP 200，Copilot 的其他模型也有成功记录。

相关 issue：

1. **11:31:14.848**，Magpie 内置 `gemini-3.8-flash` provider test 经 `/chat/completions` 返回 **HTTP 200**，耗时 5,172 ms，记录为 `kind: provider_test`、`source: probe`。原始响应正文、生成文本、完成事件均未留存，该条 usage 记录的 input/output 为 0。

timeline.body:
@TwinsDestiny 这一条也修好了，分支：https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3392-xai-required-empty（commit [16a4053b](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/16a4053b0)，基于当前 main 8abdf53a，可直接 cherry-pick）。

**根因**正是你复现出来的那一点：v0.1.1856 的修复把 `"required": null` **删掉**，但删掉的结果是"没写"，而 xAI 把没写的 `required` 同样当成 null 拒收——所以你的请求体里没有任何 null，还是报同一条 `/required: null is not of type "array"`。你的最小复现（`{"type":"object","properties":{}}` 被拒、`"required":[]` 通过）把这一点定死了。

**修复**（`internal/gateway/xai_body.go`，沿用 v0.1.1856 那处修复的位置和作用域，只对 api.x.ai 生效，直通和翻译两条路径都走）：对发往 api.x.ai 的工具 schema，凡是 `"type":"object"` 的节点、`required` 为 null **或没写**，一律补上 `"required": []`——schema 根上和嵌套里（`properties`、`items`、`anyOf`/`oneOf`/`allOf` 分支）都补；真正的数组（如 Bash 的 `["command"]`）原样保留；挂在非 object 节点上的 null `required` 仍按原样删掉；所有 object 都写齐了 `required` 的请求体一个字节不动，其他上游收到的请求也完全不变。

**验证**：按你报的原文措辞在假 xAI 上游重放了 claude 调用，工具用的是你点名的几个——`CronList`（根上没写）、`EnterPlanMode`（根上 null）、`ExitPlanMode`（properties 里嵌套的 object 没写）、`TaskStop`（根、`opts` 属性、`anyOf` 分支、`items` 里各一处，共四个 object 节点），外加 Bash 的真实 required 数组做对照。假上游按"任何 object 节点缺 required 即 400"来模拟 xAI：旧代码红（400 原文逐字复现），新代码绿，8 个缺 required 的 object 节点全部补上 `[]`，Bash 的数组原样到达。Responses 的 `parameters` 和 chat 的 `function.parameters` 两种形态同样覆盖；非 x.ai 主机收到的请求体逐字节不变。此前几轮的全部措辞（`unknown variant \`custom\``、compaction blob、Invalid message role、null required 及其数组嵌套）不回归，`go test ./internal/gateway -run 'TestXAI|TestXai|TestCustom'` 24 项绿；gateway 包全量在修复前后各跑一次，6 个失败逐个相同（均为本机已知环境性的，与本改动无关）；gofmt / go vet / go build 干净。真实 xAI 上游本地仍无法调用——方便的话在你的环境再跑一轮 claude code → x.ai 确认；如果还有别的 400，把上游返回体贴上来。

issue.title: [Bug] Codex 压缩对话时 vLLM 拒绝历史中的 custom_tool_call 输入项

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题

使用 Codex Desktop（ChatGPT.app，bundle id `com.openai.codex`）时，把模型指向 magpie 的 `localhost/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`，上游是 `http://127.0.0.1:12001/v1` 的 vLLM。该 provider 的 nativeCompaction 未开启，压缩摘要由 magpie 生成。

长对话达到上下文上限后，Codex 发起压缩请求，收到：

```json
{"error":{"code":null,"message":"localhost: Unsupported input item type: custom_tool_call (parameter=input)","param":"input","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```

会话记录（`~/.codex/sessions/2026/10/27/rollout-2026-10-27T12-35-43-...jsonl`）显示这次任务的两次尝试都失败：第一次是上下文超限（`context_length_exceeded`），第二次是上面的输入项类型错误。

## 原因

1. 压缩请求进入 `handle` 后，`codexInputAs` 把 `compaction_trigger` 改写为摘要提示，并把 `tools` 置为空数组，历史原样保留。历史中的自定义工具调用以 `custom_tool_call` 和 `custom_tool_call_output` 输入项存在。
2. 请求进入 `attempt`，该模型的 `customToolRefused` 标记尚未建立，`customOff()` 返回 false，请求经 `passthrough` 原样发给 vLLM。
3. vLLM 返回上面的 400。`passthrough` 中判断自定义工具被拒绝使用 `customToolRefusal` 正则（#2656 引入），该正则匹配 `tools` 数组相关的措辞，输入项类型的措辞不在其中。
4. `hasCustomTool` 只检查 `tools` 和携带 `tools` 的输入项。压缩请求的 `tools` 为空，历史中的调用不会被认作自定义工具。该函数开头的提前返回判断使用 `"custom"` 字面量，`custom_tool_call` 不包含这个片段，函数提前返回。
5. 模型没有被标记，也没有触发翻译后重试，每次压缩都会得到同一个 400。

## 修复方式

- `customToolRefusal` 增加输入项类型的措辞：`Unsupported`、`Unknown` 或 `Invalid`，可选的 `input`，`item type`，可选引号，然后是 `custom_tool_call`。`custom_tool_call_output` 由 `custom_tool_call` 前缀覆盖。
- `hasCustomTool` 识别 `input` 中 `type` 为 `custom_tool_call` 或 `custom_tool_call_output` 的项，提前返回判断从 `"custom"` 改为 `"custom`。
- 上游拒绝后，`passthrough` 标记模型后返回未完成状态，`attempt` 继续处理。请求在同一个 Responses API 上翻译，历史中的自定义工具调用改写为 `function_call` 和 `function_call_output`，摘要请求正常完成。

## 验证

- 新增 `TestCustomToolCallItemTranslatedWhereRefused`：历史包含自定义工具调用、`tools` 为空，上游以本次错误响应拒绝。修复前返回 400，修复后第二次请求包含 `function_call` 和 `function_call_output` 并返回 200。
- 新增 `TestCodexCompactOverCustomToolCalls`：Codex 压缩请求携带 `compaction_trigger`。修复前返回同一个 400，修复后得到摘要。
- 扩充 `TestCustomToolRefusalWordings`：覆盖本次错误响应和带引号的 `custom_tool_call_output`，并确认无关的输入项类型不会匹配。
- `go test ./internal/gateway -run 'TestCustomTool|TestCodexCompact'` 通过。
- `gofmt` 和 `go vet -tags nogui ./internal/gateway` 通过。

复现环境：magpie v0.1.1681（main `ea7c0067`）。

timeline.body:
基于当前最新的 main（`e9bde25`），把之前 required 补齐逻辑整理完善，并修复了一个在流式转发时会导致客户端直接报错拒收的阻断性问题：

### 问题背景
1. **空 object schema 缺失 required**：Claude Code 发送的无参工具（如 `CronList`、`EnterPlanMode`）缺少 `required` 字段，xAI 仍会按 null 校验报错 `400 [standard_violation] /required: null is not of type "array"`。
2. **xAI 流式响应缺失 index 字段**：在 xAI 的 Anthropic 兼容流式输出中，所有的 `content_block_delta` 事件都漏掉了 `index` 字段（仅在 start 和 stop 事件中带有），导致部分严格校验协议格式的客户端解码器（例如 ZCode 等）报错 `["index"]: expected number, received undefined` 并直接判错丢弃整轮输出。

### 修复与分支
- `toolsRequiredFilled`：递归确保所有 `type: "object"` 节点在缺失或为 null 时补全 `"required": []`，原有的有效数组保持原样；
- `xaiIndexTidy`：在 SSE 流式 passthrough 链路中跟踪活跃的 block index，并自动为缺失 index 的 `content_block_delta` 补齐 index；
- 附带了自包含的单元测试（`xai_body_test.go` 与 `xai_stream_index_test.go`）以及文档更新。
